inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped RIGHT JOIN preserves a row from the right relation while an ordered GROUP_CONCAT consumes nullable left-side values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one matching and one right-only agent. The focused query isolates RIGHT JOIN null extension, COUNT of a nullable joined key, and COALESCE around ordered GROUP_CONCAT without the source schema or application context.

fixture_notes: Agent 21 has one fixed session and agent 22 has none. The grouped RIGHT JOIN must return both agents, count only the matching session, and render <none> for the right-only row.
determinism_notes: Agent IDs, session IDs, labels, aggregate ordering, separator, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE session_agents_min (agent_id INT PRIMARY KEY, agent_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE agent_sessions_min (session_id INT PRIMARY KEY, agent_id INT NOT NULL, session_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT a.agent_id, a.agent_name, COUNT(s.session_id) AS session_count, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(s.session_label ORDER BY s.session_id ASC SEPARATOR '|'), '<none>') AS session_labels FROM agent_sessions_min AS s RIGHT JOIN session_agents_min AS a ON a.agent_id = s.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_id, a.agent_name ORDER BY a.agent_id
